2_method_definition.question: 最终主方法定义是什么？
2_method_definition.answer: Prediction Consistency: R_PC(q) = 1 - mean pairwise IoU of segmentations from m=6 references. Coverage-based abstention with CFR and AURC as primary metrics.

3_fresh_cohort.question: 是否找到fresh cohort？
3_fresh_cohort.details: 所有候选数据集（MoNuSAC, MoNuSeg, IDRID）均已暴露。GlaS/CPM17/Formal_Test需要用户批准下载。论文定位为exploratory/benchmark。

4_freshness.question: fresh cohort是否真正未观察？
4_freshness.details: 无fresh cohort。Development Cohort（80 queries）和Validation Cohort（41 queries）均已被观察。

5_power_n.question: power analysis建议N是多少？
5_power_n.details: min N for power >= 0.80: 20, min N for events >= 10: 75

11_datasets_support.question: 哪些datasets支持？

12_boundary_datasets.question: 哪些datasets是边界？
12_boundary_datasets.answer: MoNuSeg (CFR=0, risk signal transfers but no failures to detect), IDRID (segmentation quality too low, risk signal transfers but impractical)

15_modern_pipeline.question: 是否运行现代pipeline？
15_modern_pipeline.answer: NO — DINOv3/SAM3 not available locally. SAM2.1-Base+, SAM2.1-Large, and SAM-H are available for future extension.
15_modern_pipeline.details: DINOv3 + SAM3 would require new model downloads and user approval.

16_final_claim.question: 最终论文主张是什么？
16_final_claim.answer: Cross-reference prediction consistency provides a simple, GT-free signal for ranking segmentation risk and reducing catastrophic failures through selective prediction in multi-reference visual prompting.
16_final_claim.details: Only 3 contributions: (1) RRE problem formulation, (2) Prediction Consistency risk signal, (3) Systematic evaluation across pipelines and datasets.

17_title.question: 推荐标题是什么？
17_title.answer: When References Disagree: Prediction Consistency for Selective Visual Prompting
17_title.details: Alternative: Prediction Consistency as a Simple Risk Signal for Multi-Reference Visual Prompting

18_submission_ready.details: Passed 12/15 gates. Failed: fresh cohort (no confirmatory data), external support (only boundary datasets). Paper is suitable for workshop/benchmark venues.
